title: Fifteen years later, the Apple Cards origin story
summary: This article traces the origin story of Apple Card fifteen years after the initial concept or key decisions that led to its 2019 launch, providing behind-the-scenes insights into Apple's entry into the fintech space and its partnership with Goldman Sachs.
problem_solved: How Apple approached and solved the challenge of entering the competitive credit card market with a design-focused, privacy-centric financial product.
why_valuable: Provides historical context and strategic insights into how Apple developed one of the most successful modern credit cards, revealing the business decisions and design philosophy behind its creation.
